name: Mistform Sliver — 60 creature types of your choice all apply (no 50-effect cap per layer)
notes: Reported 2026-11-23 (Conor's biggest Embiggen combo: Mindlink Mech activated 366 times). applyLayerGlobal stopped after 50 passes (MAX_ITER = 50), one effect applied per pass, so every layer-4 effect past the 50th was silently dropped: the Mech stopped at the 36th type. The cap is now effects.length + 1.

scryfallData.flavor_text: Taking the form of a junior researcher, the first sliver slipped out of Riptide.
